name: CA.gov
body: Every image has alt text, security.txt is published, Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors, and JSON-LD names a GovernmentOrganization. But DMARC is p=none, so spoofed ca.gov mail is reported, not stopped.
lesson: After reviewing DMARC reports, move to p=quarantine and then p=reject, so forged mail is blocked.
summary: www.ca.gov scores 92 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 13 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: analytics may count some visits twice.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages send to more than one GA4 property.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 10 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: No llms.txt was found
fix.evidence: /llms.txt returned 404. It is a proposed convention that some AI tools read to find the pages that matter.
fix.fix: Publish /llms.txt. The fix kit has a draft built from this review.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 499 ms
Every page has a meta description
